title: Implement ObjectStack kernel API specifications (P0/P1/P2)
body:
Implements batch operations, metadata caching, error standardization, full-text search, and view persistence APIs to support ObjectUI requirements.

## Batch Operations (`batch.zod.ts`)

Added `updateMany`/`deleteMany` with atomic transaction support:

```typescript
// POST /api/v1/data/{object}/batch
{
  operation: 'update',
  records: [
    { id: '1', data: { status: 'active' } },
    { id: '2', data: { status: 'active' } }
  ],
  options: {
    atomic: true,           // rollback on any failure
    returnRecords: true,    // include full records in response
    continueOnError: false  // stop on first error
  }
}
```

Max 200 records/batch. Partial success handling with per-record error details.

## Metadata Cache Control (`cache.zod.ts`)

ETag-based conditional requests for metadata endpoints:

```typescript
// Request with If-None-Match header
const response = await client.meta.getCached('account', {
  ifNoneMatch: '"686897696a7c876b7e"'
});

// Returns 304 Not Modified if unchanged
if (response.notModified) {
  // use cached version
} else {
  // update cache with response.data, response.etag
}
```

Selective invalidation by target type (object/field/permission/layout).

## Error Standardization (`errors.zod.ts`)

50+ machine-readable error codes with categorization, HTTP status mapping, and retry guidance:

```typescript
{
  code: 'validation_error',
  message: 'Validation failed for 2 fields',
  category: 'validation',
  httpStatus: 400,
  retryable: false,
  fieldErrors: [
    { field: 'email', code: 'invalid_format', value: 'not-an-email' },
    { field: 'age', code: 'value_out_of_range', value: 150, constraint: { max: 120 } }
  ]
}
```

## Full-Text Search (extended `query.zod.ts`)

Added `search` parameter with fuzzy matching, field boosting, and language analysis:

```typescript
{
  object: 'article',
  search: {
    query: 'machine learning',
    fields: ['title', 'content'],
    fuzzy: true,
    boost: { title: 2.0, content: 1.0 },
    language: 'en',
    highlight: true
  },
  where: { published: true },
  limit: 10
}
```

## View Persistence (`view-storage.zod.ts`)

Save/share UI configurations for list, kanban, calendar, chart views. Supports column layouts, filters, sorting, and per-user defaults.

## Notes

- Field-level permissions, GraphQL, audit logs already existed
- WebSocket/SSE realtime subscriptions already implemented
- Aggregation queries (`$groupby`, `$aggregate`) already supported
- Added 85 tests, all 2164 tests passing

<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 5️⃣ ObjectStack 内核需求
> 
> 为充分发挥 ObjectUI 的能力，建议 @objectstack 内核 提供以下功能：
> 
> 5.1 必需功能
> 
> 功能	优先级	说明
> 批量更新 API	P0	client.data.updateMany(resource, records[])
> 元数据缓存控制	P0	client.meta.getCached() 或 ETag 支持
> 错误码标准化	P0	统一错误响应格式
> WebSocket/SSE 支持	P1	实时数据订阅
> 字段级权限	P1	支持字段级读/写权限
> 批量操作事务	P1	原子性批量操作
> 5.2 增强功能
> 
> 功能	优先级	说明
> GraphQL 端点	P2	可选的 GraphQL API
> 全文搜索	P2	$search 参数支持
> 聚合查询	P2	$groupby, $aggregate
> 视图定义存储	P2	存储 UI 视图配置
> 审计日志	P2	数据变更历史
> 5.3 API 规范建议
> 
> 批量更新 API
> 
> // POST /api/v1/data/{object}/batch
> {
>   "operation": "update",
>   "records": [
>     { "id": "1", "name": "Updated Name 1" },
>     { "id": "2", "name": "Updated Name 2" }
>   ],
>   "options": {
>     "atomic": true,  // 事务性
>     "returnRecords": true
>   }
> }
> 
> // Response
> {
>   "success": true,
>   "updated": 2,
>   "records": [...],
>   "errors": []
> }
> 实时订阅 API
> 
> // WebSocket: ws://api/v1/realtime
> {
>   "action": "subscribe",
>   "resource": "contacts",
>   "filters": { "status": "active" },
>   "events": ["create", "update", "delete"]
> }
> 
> // 服务器推送
> {
>   "event": "update",
>   "resource": "contacts",
>   "data": { "id": "123", "name": "John Doe" },
>   "timestamp": "2026-01-29T12:00:00Z"
> }


</details>
